disposition_reason: Intranasal ferric ammonium citrate in mice; relative olfactory bulb iron increases by ICP-MS; no food or environmental occurrence data.

study.method: ICP-MS of digested olfactory bulb; Perls-DAB; RNA-seq; western blot

regulatory_or_exposure: Intranasal ferric ammonium citrate 200 mg/kg (250 mg/mL) twice every other day (Methods)
Olfactory bulb iron-56 +59.66%, iron-57 +56.52% vs saline (Results; Fig. 2E)
Serum iron unchanged; CSF iron undetectable (Results; Fig. 2H)
non_numeric_findings: Olfactory function impaired; dopaminergic and glutamatergic neurons and oligodendrocytes affected, GABAergic neurons spared.
Microglia and astrocytes activated; no ferroptosis signature.
